comment: Free-for-all Pistol start on map 1, now Larak Lot (wave 2 FFA kit lane). Run tools/qa_tour.sh with FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/ffa-kit.json, FRAGR_QA_BOTS=2 and the default free-for-all server. The pad routes are the arena tour's Larak Lot routes (client/qa/tour.json), one alternative per spawn quarter. The joined human starts on the Pistol and Fists, takes the Shotgun and the Railgun from their pads, then walks into the hub until a rival frags it so the death card names what the life lost. Inspection only; not a tour publish.

states.name: kit_overview
states.note: Larak Lot from above with its pads. From this height the pad items read only as small marks; the first-person states show taking them.

states.note: Down in the hub with the Shotgun and Railgun: the death card names the killer, the view, the four second countdown and LOST SHOTGUN + RAILGUN on a level baseline.
